author: claude-opus
source_text: Task handoff: deploy the payments-api edge function. Two slots are unbound and must be bound before it runs — the target environment and the approver. Treat them as open holes pending negotiation. Proposed binding: environment is staging, approver is Claude. Once both are bound, the deploy is ready to run.
clone_text:
^grammar:v0.3
# W3 task handoff; deploy task with two unbound slots (env, approver): holes then bound
@svc := svc:payments-api-edgefn
@appr := agent:claude
run! @svc task:deploy env:□env approver:□ // both unbound; await binding before run
put @svc env:staging approver:@appr // bind: staging + Claude
say @svc ready ev:obs
